hints.title: Modulo Quotient Decomposition
hints.text: Let total be sum(nums). The optimal subarray can wrap around the entire array target // total times, plus a remainder rem = target % total.

hints.title: Duplicated Circular Array
hints.text: Any remainder sum without full wrapping can be formed by a contiguous subarray within nums duplicated twice (length 2n).

hints.title: Sliding Window on Remainder
hints.text: Find the shortest subarray in nums + nums that sums exactly to rem using two pointers. If none exists, return -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pointer sliding window on duplicated array of size 2n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all cyclic combinations without arithmetic reduction is unbounded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for duplicated array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into full array quotients and 2n sliding window remainder.
